name: anything-llm
description: The best solution for turning private documents into a chat bot using off-the-shelf tools and commercially viable AI technologies.
author: Timothy Carambat (Mintplex Labs)

scripts.setup: cd server && yarn && cd ../collector && yarn && cd ../frontend && yarn && cd .. && yarn setup:envs && yarn prisma:setup && echo "Please run yarn dev:server, yarn dev:collector, and yarn dev:frontend in separate terminal tabs."
scripts.setup:envs:
cp -n ./frontend/.env.example ./frontend/.env; cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development; cp -n ./collector/.env.example ./collector/.env; cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env; echo "All ENV files copied!
"
scripts.dev:reader-worker: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=reader-worker node reader-worker.js
scripts.dev:background-worker: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=background-worker ATHENA_BACKGROUND_INLINE=false node background-worker.js
scripts.dev:realtime-gateway: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=realtime-gateway node realtime-gateway.js
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: yarn prisma:generate && yarn prisma:migrate && yarn prisma:seed
scripts.prisma:reset: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js migrate reset --force
scripts.desktop:prepare: cd frontend && yarn build && cd ../desktop && npm run prepare:desktop
scripts.desktop:security: cd desktop && npm test && npm run security:audit
scripts.desktop:dist:win: cd frontend && yarn build && cd ../desktop && npm run dist:win
scripts.translations:normalize: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && cd frontend && yarn lint && cd .. && yarn translations:verify
scripts.translations:prune: cd frontend/src/locales && node findUnusedTranslations.mjs --delete && cd ../../../ && yarn translations:normalize
